question: Who conducts elections for both the houses of Parliament in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Election Commission**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Election Commission of India** is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India at both the national and state levels.
 
• It ensures **free and fair elections** to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State Legislative Assemblies, as well as the offices of the President and Vice President in the country.
